headlines.title: China’s factory-gate prices growth slows to 3.5% in July amid lower fuel prices
headlines.summary:
China’s factory-gate prices growth slowed in July, as lower domestic fuel prices eased cost pressures triggered by the US-Israel war on Iran, while high temperatures dragged manufacturing.
The producer price index (PPI) rose by 3.5 per cent year on year last month, compared with 4.1 per cent in June, according to data released by the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) on Sunday.

headlines.title: 在岸人民币对美元汇率盘中创2023年2月6日以来新高
headlines.summary: 8月10日，在岸人民币对美元汇率盘中创2023年2月6日以来新高。Wind数据显示，截至16时30分，在岸人民币对美元汇率收盘价报6.7442元，较前收盘价上涨59个基点，盘中最高报6.7432元。中国工商银行（亚洲）研究报告表示，展望下半年，人民币对美元汇率大概率延续波动、缓步走升态势。主要影响因素在于，下半年我国出口预计延续韧性增长，国际资金增配人民币资产，资金净流入支持人民币中枢走强。此外，需关注地缘风险及关税政策对出口产品和地区结构、量价关系分化等影响。（中证金牛座）

headlines.title_en: USD/CNY onshore rate hits new high since February 6, 2023 during trading
headlines.summary_en: On August 10, the onshore RMB exchange rate against the dollar hit an intraday high not seen since February 6, 2023. Wind data shows that as of 16:30, the onshore RMB closed at 6.7442 per dollar, up 59 basis points from the previous close, with an intraday high of 6.7432. ICBC (Asia) research report says that looking ahead to the second half of the year, the RMB exchange rate against the dollar is likely to continue fluctuating and appreciate gradually. Key drivers include resilient export growth, increased global capital allocation to RMB assets, and net capital inflows supporting a stronger RMB center. Additionally, attention should be paid to the impact of geopolitical risks and tariff policies on export product and regional structures, as well as divergences in volume-price dynamics. (China Securities Journal Jin Niu)
